Define relevant costs and benefits, giving proper treatment to sunk costs, opportunity costs, and unit costs; prepare analyses of special decisions; accept or reject a special order; outsource a product or service; add or drop a service or product; and sell or process further a product.
Explain the nature of capital expenditure decisions and apply and evaluate various methods used in making these decisions.
